body:
Source: GitHub issue #807 (release-audit class secrets, P1-high, security). Re-verified on main @ e2bc60ab: `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs`'s `recordBuildGateBypass` (around line 206) does `spawnSync('adlc', ['gate-manifest', 'record', 'build-gate-bypass', ...], { encoding: 'utf8', ...(cwd ? {cwd} : {}) })` — a BARE PATH lookup for `'adlc'` with NO explicit `env`, so the child inherits the hook process's FULL environment, including `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY` if present. `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs` (the sibling hook in this same plugin) establishes the correct threat model in detail: a repository can ship `node_modules/.bin/adlc` (or any other same-uid-writable PATH entry) ahead of a real install, so its OWN recovery-audit spawn (around line 970-990) resolves the binary through `resolveTrustedBinary(name, pathEnv)` (skips node_modules dirs, checks the resolved file's uid matches the current process — exported from `adlc-handoff-gate.mjs`), invokes it via `process.execPath` to avoid a second PATH lookup through the shebang, and builds the child's env from a local `RECOVERY_AUDIT_ENV_ALLOWLIST` array (currently NOT exported) so `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY`/`ADLC_ADMIN_KEY` never reach the child at all. `adlc-build-gate.mjs` ALREADY imports `resolveTrustedBinary` from `./adlc-handoff-gate.mjs` (it is used correctly elsewhere in the same file, around line 309: `adlcBinPath: resolveTrustedBinary('adlc', process.env.PATH)`) — `recordBuildGateBypass`'s spawn just never uses it.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `plugins/adlc-codex`: hooks/{adlc-build-gate,adlc-handoff-gate,adlc-lifecycle,adlc-rails-guard,handoff-resolve,tail-read-worker}.mjs. `resolveTrustedBinary(name, pathEnv)` is defined and exported in `adlc-handoff-gate.mjs` (never throws; returns `null` on no match — the caller must handle a null resolution). `RECOVERY_AUDIT_ENV_ALLOWLIST` is currently an UN-exported `const` array in `adlc-handoff-gate.mjs` (around line 1038) — it needs to become `export const` so `adlc-build-gate.mjs` can import and reuse the exact same allowlist (single source of truth, per the issue's own recommendation to 'mirror the architecture the CI cross-model-gate already uses correctly'). Tests: root runner segment `codex hooks` = `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Export `RECOVERY_AUDIT_ENV_ALLOWLIST` from `adlc-handoff-gate.mjs` (add `export` to its declaration; change nothing about its contents — this is a visibility change only, matching how `resolveTrustedBinary` is already exported from the same file).
2. In `adlc-build-gate.mjs`, import `RECOVERY_AUDIT_ENV_ALLOWLIST` alongside the already-imported `resolveTrustedBinary`. Rewrite `recordBuildGateBypass`'s spawn: resolve the binary path via `resolveTrustedBinary('adlc', process.env.PATH)`; if resolution fails (returns `null`), the function must NOT fall back to a bare `'adlc'` spawn — return `false` (or whatever this function's existing 'could not record, best-effort' contract is; read its doc comment and callers before deciding, and preserve that contract for the not-found case) rather than silently taking the insecure bare-PATH path. When resolution succeeds, spawn via `process.execPath` with the resolved script path as the first argv (mirroring the handoff gate's `process.execPath` pattern — avoids a second, unguarded PATH lookup through a shebang), and build the child's `env` from `RECOVERY_AUDIT_ENV_ALLOWLIST` only (same construction pattern as the handoff gate's recovery-audit spawn), never the inherited `process.env`.
3. Preserve `recordBuildGateBypass`'s existing signature and its `cwd` passthrough behaviour exactly — this is a spawn-mechanics change only, not a behavioural/API change for callers.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 With `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY` set in the test process's env and a fake `spawnSync` injected (or spawn a real tiny script that just dumps its env to a file), `recordBuildGateBypass`'s child process env does NOT contain `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY` (or any key outside `RECOVERY_AUDIT_ENV_ALLOWLIST`). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/build-gate-bypass-trusted-spawn.test.mjs`
- AC2 With a fake same-uid `adlc` shim placed at a `node_modules/.bin/` PATH entry ahead of a legitimate one on PATH, `recordBuildGateBypass` does NOT execute the `node_modules` shim (resolveTrustedBinary's existing node_modules-skip behaviour is exercised through this call site now, not just the handoff gate's). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/build-gate-bypass-trusted-spawn.test.mjs`
- AC3 When `resolveTrustedBinary` returns `null` (no trusted binary found), `recordBuildGateBypass` returns its documented not-recorded value and does NOT spawn anything at all (no bare-PATH fallback). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/build-gate-bypass-trusted-spawn.test.mjs`
- AC4 `RECOVERY_AUDIT_ENV_ALLOWLIST` is importable from `adlc-handoff-gate.mjs` and `adlc-build-gate.mjs` imports the SAME array reference (not a re-declared copy) — grep-verifiable. verify: `grep -c "export const RECOVERY_AUDIT_ENV_ALLOWLIST" plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs` (expect 1) and `grep -c "RECOVERY_AUDIT_ENV_ALLOWLIST" plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs` (expect >= 1)
- AC5 Existing suite green (confirm actual baseline; the existing `build-gate.test.mjs`, `build-gate-recovery-exception.test.mjs`, and `build-gate-space-path.test.mjs` must still pass — if any pinned the OLD bare-spawn shape, rewrite it and say so in the PR body). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: `adlc-rails-guard.mjs`'s uncaught-throw fail-open (issue #804 — a distinct bug in the same plugin, do not fold it in); any change to `resolveTrustedBinary`'s own implementation (it is already correct — reuse it, don't modify it).

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/build-gate-bypass-trusted-spawn.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: the package suite, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then the cross-model review loop (see lane instructions) until a round is clean. Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/{adlc-build-gate,adlc-handoff-gate}.mjs, the new test, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(adlc-codex): ...`, body must contain `Closes #807`.
title: plugin(adlc-codex): resolve the build-gate-bypass spawn through resolveTrustedBinary and a scrubbed env, matching the handoff gate's threat model
